Flow.description: Screen Flow: Individual Application Examination. The Board's seven exam applications from the School Forms packet, filed by a School Administrator for a student: national exam, national retake, alternative hair design practical and state, practical and state, 1400 hour practical and state, retake exam(s) and no-show exam(s). Each keeps its own sections and wording. Creates an Examination application with the exams, dates and hours, the no-show acknowledgement and any accommodation request, the documents the form lists, and the fees printed on the form, from the Fee Schedule.

formulas.expression: {!WF_Form} = "Application for National Exam" || {!WF_Form} = "Application for National Retake Exam"

formulas.name: forB_IsAhd
formulas.expression: {!WF_Form} = "Application for Alternative Hair Design Practical and State Exam"

formulas.name: forB_IsPracticalAndState
formulas.description: An application for both the practical and state exams.
formulas.expression: {!WF_Form} = "Application for Alternative Hair Design Practical and State Exam" || {!WF_Form} = "Application for Practical and State Exam" || {!WF_Form} = "1400 Hour Application for Practical and State Examinations"

formulas.name: forB_Is1400
formulas.expression: {!WF_Form} = "1400 Hour Application for Practical and State Examinations"

formulas.name: forB_ChoosesExams
formulas.expression: {!WF_Form} = "Application for Retake Exam(s)" || {!WF_Form} = "Application for No Show Exam(s)"

formulas.name: forT_ApplicationType
formulas.description: The application type for the form chosen.
formulas.expression: CASE({!WF_Form}, "Application for National Exam", "National Exam", "Application for National Retake Exam", "National Retake", "Application for Alternative Hair Design Practical and State Exam", "Practical and State", "Application for Practical and State Exam", "Practical and State", "1400 Hour Application for Practical and State Examinations", "Practical and State 1400 Hour", "Application for Retake Exam(s)", "Exam Retake", "Application for No Show Exam(s)", "No Show", "")

formulas.name: forT_LicenseTypeName
formulas.expression: IF({!forB_IsAhd}, "Alternative Hair Design Permit", CASE({!ED_License}, "Cosmetology", "Cosmetologist", "Manicurist", "Manicurist", "Esthetician", "Esthetician", "Alternative Hair Design", "Alternative Hair Design Permit", "Instructor", {!ED_InstructorLicense}, ""))
